app.title: Show HN: LightCloud – A cloud console organised like file system
app.author: yullius
app.description: Web-based console that provides a file‑system‑style interface to manage cloud resources, including compute, storage, and networking services.

proposed_tests.test: Spin up a local Docker container using the CLI and verify resource creation
Create a file in the console and confirm it appears in the underlying storage backend
Delete a resource via the UI and check API status
Measure latency of creating 50 concurrent resources
Verify authentication flow with a test OAuth provider
